escalation_condition: Person cannot cough, speak, breathe, or turns blue/clutches neck (universal choking sign)
source: Resuscitation Council / Red Cross Choking Management Protocol
approved_actions: Ask 'Are you choking? Can you speak?' If they can cough forcefully, encourage continued coughing.
If they cannot speak or make sound, deliver 5 firm back blows between shoulder blades with heel of hand.
If back blows fail, perform 5 abdominal thrusts (Heimlich maneuver) inward and upward just above the navel.
Alternate 5 back blows and 5 abdominal thrusts until object is expelled or help arrives.
If the person loses consciousness, lower them gently to the floor and prepare for chest compressions.
critical_actions: Act immediately if no air movement or voice is present.
Switch between 5 back blows and 5 abdominal thrusts.
contraindications: Never perform blind finger sweeps in the mouth.
Do not give water to a choking person.
